text:
Model	STI-240FE
Product Name	6 port 10/100Mbps Industrial Ethernet Switch
Fixed Port	4*10/100M RJ45 port / 2*100M integrated optical port (optional 1310/1550)
Bandwidth	1.6Gbps
Packet Forwarding	0.9Mpps
MAC	1K
Buffer	768K
Transmission Distance	10BASE-T: Cat3,4,5 UTP(≤250 meter) / 100BASE-TX: Cat5 or later UTP(150 meter)
Optical Media	SFP: 1000M single and multimode optical module, Max distance≤100Km
LED Indicator	PWR: Power indicator (green) / Port: green _10M network connection indicator / green+orange _100M network connection indicator. / 5-6: Optical fiber connection indicator (green) / V1: Main power indicator (green) / V2: slave power indicator (green) / V3:DC power indicator (green)
Power	Three groups of independent power input / SW: DC 12-57V
Operating Temperature/Humidity	-40～80°C；10%～90% RH No condensation
Storage Temperature/Humidity	-40～85°C；5%～95% RH No condensation
Dimension / L*W*H	Device: 156mm*113mm*40mm / Packing Box: 235mm*105mm*78mm
N.W/G.W(Kg)	0.9Kg/1.1Kg
Lightning / Protection Level	6KV 8/20us；8KV ESD electrostatic protection / IP40
Installation	Desktop, Wall, Rack mountable(with mounting hangers)
Certificate	CE-EMC EN55032; CE-LVD EN62368 / FCC Part 15Class B; RoHS
Warranty	3 Years
